g.text: Leaf Detail, active and passive · P-1 · X

svg.text: Glass 24mm 6x12x6 · 3 hinges per leaf · barrel 102, set out to its top
Hinge rule: 3 per leaf, 4 on a leaf over 2100
Handing: Hinge left · opens outward (seen from inside)
Handle 949 above the leaf bottom (1000 above the floor), backset 45
Meeting stile 100 (94 + lip 6), half lapped; active leaf laps on the exterior
Lock: ThunderBolt kit on the active leaf; bolts top and bottom on the passive leaf
Rails run the full leaf width, stiles the full leaf height (cut list lengths)
